title: PvE DPS
description: Level-60 dungeons and the raids that open December 9. One letter per damage spec. Tanks and healers are on their own lists.
basis: L60 projection from beta build 1.60.1.70124 talent data and the 20 DPS spec files. Cross-checked against the public rankings wowforever.co indexed on 2026-10-01. Item stats are still hidden, so this is not a parse.

entries.note: The spec file says roll Arcane. Every indexed list that ranks it puts it in its own top band.
Top-rated DoT engine in the spec file. Three of four indexed lists put it in their top band.
The Warrior damage spec. Lists put it above Arms. Rage bugs are still open, so this is not proven.
Pet damage and Bestial Wrath. The safe Hunter invite until Survival's melee kit is tested at 60.
Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot. Two lists say A. One pre-beta forum post said F. We are not taking the forum post.
Highest ceiling in the Hunter file, and every signature talent is past the point the beta has played.
Poison uptime on a boss that stands still. The spec file's PvE pick over Combat.
Shadowform and a personal Shadow Weaving. Two lists say A. You are not buffing the other caster.
Lava Burst and crit damage at the bottom of the tree. The file calls it weak before 40 and real at 60.
Ignite and Combustion. A on two lists, F on a forum post. The file says unproven, not bad.
Conflagrate and Incinerate. A on the indexed DPS lists. Hard casts, so movement hurts.
Eclipse and a party crit aura. Light on AoE. A on two lists, and the file does not claim the meter.
The file says mid-pack PvE and tells you to pick Fury if raid damage is the only goal.
Blade Flurry for trash. The file sends boss damage to Assassination.
Stormstrike and Maelstrom. Rebuilt, and the indexed lists leave it a band under Elemental.
Icy Veins says it will not top the meters. Three indexed lists put it at B. Winter's Chill is the invite.
The file's dungeon call is bear tank, not cat DPS. Cat is the PvP build. Listed here because the role is melee.
The file says do not bring it as the raid plan until someone parses it. Opener kit, not a boss kit.
Rankings are split, including a seller D and a forum A. The file calls it high variance. Not a recommendation.
Has a rotation now. The indexed lists still put it in their low band, and the file does not overrule them.
